boundaries.query: One NFC-normalized query, deduplicated terms <= original 200-character schema bound; ICU words only for CJK fragments.
boundaries.catalog: One catalog snapshot per search; 2 normalizations/eligible item for non-category queries, zero per-term normalization. No concatenated full haystack.
boundaries.allocations: Existing async execute/result and activation map/filter/spread remain explicit command lifecycle allocations. New query Set/Array.from/ICU segment records die with the query; candidates <= eligible catalog size. No per-frame/event changes.
boundaries.release: Old catalog array and objects are collected while extension and result details remain alive, on normal activation/rejection/throw. Clear uses next catalog snapshot; no index/cache. Execute has no asynchronous suspension before matching/activation, no new abort owner.
boundaries.pilot: 256-iteration pilot had zero CPU samples at Windows process.cpuUsage resolution; excluded from final comparisons and replaced by 4096 iterations. No object pool or performance fallback.

baseline.notes: Explicit-search boundary only; no catalog index/cache or work on frame/event delivery. Substring comparisons and sort comparisons are counted separately. Caller-owned match names/details remain alive during catalog GC checks.
